releases.name: DS Style Merkin Mix 8.4.1 — BLUE Test 4 (Hardware Untested)
releases.body:
**NEWER EZ-FLASH OMEGA DEFINITIVE EDITION B / BLUE ONLY — HARDWARE UNTESTED. UPDATE AT YOUR OWN RISK.**

Do not install on the older DE Rev. A/B, Original OMEGA, or another model.

Software regression checks passed; installation, boot, saves, plugins, NOR timing and runtime stack peaks remain physically unverified. Stock-size bounds do not prove updater acceptance. Native 64 MiB clean loading remains; new large-ROM add-ons and physical warm return are unqualified. Flash polling and SD/NOR power-loss limits remain.

Back up the SD card and `.esv` saves. Old emulator save states are not guaranteed compatible; prefer in-game battery saves when transitioning.

Download **`ezbluekernel.bin`** (2,124,252 bytes) with the correct model-compatible `SYSTEM` setup. GitHub supplies source archives automatically.

Use the packed `.bin`, not the raw development `.gba`.

SHA-256: `57db5bb4e9fd2cfacdbb1024b6d2d62dd7a83c562964f440d3e5cf02203549a3`

### New features

- Adopted a **firmware-free, stock-size BLUE update** informed by **FrankieT19's BLUE port**: 2,124,252 bytes instead of 3,988,120, with current artwork and MiGoomba retained. Use the official BLUE kernel for FPGA updates.
- Added complete-image integrity checks for Load style. The new DSSMM BLUE seal checks the model/header, exact size and CRC before staging an update.

### New fixes

- Block new game/save loads and manual FRAM operations while an earlier battery-save backup is still pending.
- Stop startup/NOR browsing from writing metadata; recognise factory-erased catalog/map data in RAM, require allocation-map agreement, preserve unknown reservations and sort entries by physical ROM page.
- Reserve the full NOR add-on extent and reject invalid patch offsets or programming-block crossings; store launcher preferences separately from stock Mode B.
- Correct SD save-state staging to BLUE's DDR memory, check exact size/signature and file errors, and create missing states without overwriting files after an I/O error.
- Block new and existing **NOR add-ons with save states** until their persistent SD-sector maps and runtime are validated. Existing entries/files are preserved; turn save states off when writing NOR add-ons.

### Summary of past features

- **MiGoomba v0.1** by **michyprima** for GB/GBC, retaining per-game `.esv` paths and 64 KiB save handling; based on Jagoomba Color, Goomba Color and Goomba.
- **FrankieT19's DS Style foundation and separate v8.0 interface work:** Start screen, themes, sounds, selection/launch effects, Auto theme, View grouping, Open SYSTEM, boot preferences and favorites behavior.
- List, List + Art and horizontal/vertical carousels, title/box art and side previews; favorites, recents, last-played startup, accent colors and readable settings.
- Name/header-code/mirrored artwork, long filenames, marked transparency and custom fallbacks; cached/scaled previews and optimized artwork lookup/rendering.
- Optional remembered cheats, off by default, by **exploitz86**, with collapsible groups from **SkillerCMP**, adapted by **exploitz86**; multilingual support including Thai/Chinese and a text/Markdown viewer.
- BLUE-native 64 MiB/5G handling, hardware drivers, in-game options and NOR allocation; themed NOR progress and SD-side NOR artwork paths.

### Summary of past fixes

- Guarded embedded-emulator payload sizes/alignment and tested exact game offsets, DMA copies and cache bounds.
- Bounded NES detection/patch writes, full-width cheat/save sizes and malformed marked artwork; corrected Chinese paths and stopped save loading on close errors.
- Checked game/plugin limits, SD reads/copies/closes, compressed payloads and stack-safe boot; restored small headerless plugins and directory records after failed loads.
- Safer staged saves/settings and filename checks; bounded PSRAM/NOR patch copies, consistent block padding, NOR erase/program/catalog readback and reserve-before-publish ordering.
- Preserved cheat-group selection/visible-row fixes and removed the black plugin-launch strip; checked kernel staging before replacing an update file.

Thanks to **FrankieT19**, **EZ-FLASH**, **Sterophonick**, **exploitz86**, **SkillerCMP**, **aidiadayo**, **Kekun** and **ChaN**; and to **michyprima**, **Jaga / EvilJagaGenius**, **Dwedit** and **FluBBa** for the emulator lineage. Merkin Mix artwork and port work is maintained by **Merkin / voluptuary**. [Credits and provenance](https://github.com/voluptuary/dssmm/blob/v8.4.1-blue-test4/ezfblue/CREDITS.md).

This project was developed with AI assistance.

releases.name: DS Style Merkin Mix 8.4.0 — EZ-FLASH OMEGA DE
releases.body:
**EZ-FLASH OMEGA DEFINITIVE EDITION REV. A/B ONLY.**

Do not install on Original OMEGA or the newer DE B / BLUE.

Production and software/emulator regression checks passed. No new physical Rev. A/B MiGoomba validation is recorded. Existing flash polling, interrupted NOR catalogs and SD rename/power-loss limits remain; avoid interruption during writes.

Back up the SD card and `.esv` saves. Old emulator save states are not guaranteed compatible; prefer in-game battery saves when transitioning.

Download **`ezkernelnew.bin`** (2,030,600 bytes). GitHub supplies source archives automatically.

SHA-256: `5037473f5992f745e8d29d2df34e12996a76aaac2ccde51786f99b5432827d48`

### New features

- Replaced the built-in GB/GBC emulator with **MiGoomba v0.1** by **michyprima**, based on Jagoomba Color, Goomba Color and Goomba. DE-specific clock/rumble behavior is retained.

### New fixes

- Added embedded-emulator size/alignment guards and loader regression checks for exact game offsets, DMA copies and cache bounds.

### Summary of past features

- **FrankieT19's DS Style v7.5 foundation and separate v8.0 UI work:** Start screen, selection effects, sounds/pop-ups, loading ring/fade, Auto theme, View grouping, Open SYSTEM, boot preferences and favorites shortcuts.
- List, List + Art and horizontal/vertical carousels; title/box art, side previews, configurable borders/corners, favorites, recents and last-played startup.
- Name-matched, header-code, mirrored and nested NOR artwork; custom/per-extension fallbacks, marked transparency, console icons, square/wide art and CUSTOM Only rounded corners.
- Themes, accent colors, customizable launcher/Start layouts, multilingual settings/help, Thai/Chinese support and a text/Markdown viewer; Clean list, wrap scopes, 12/24-hour clocks and hidden-system controls.
- Optional remembered cheats, off by default, by **exploitz86**, with collapsible groups originating with **SkillerCMP** and adapted by **exploitz86**.
- Themed NOR writing progress and selected-game save-recovery artwork; kernel installation from `/SYSTEM/KERNELS`; faster artwork rendering/indexed lookup and 832 bytes less working-RAM use.

### Summary of past fixes

- Safer staged saves/settings with previous-file retention on write failures; checked save/copy reads, full-width sizes, close failures, backups and valid Chinese/mixed-case paths.
- Bounded game/plugin loading, PSRAM-bank handling, NOR patch writes and NES detection/patching; malformed/incomplete input and stale detection are rejected.
- Safer plugin boot/stack handoff and decompression; restored small headerless plugins, correct argument names and directory rebuilds after failed loads; removed the black launch strip.
- Corrected transparency/art alignment, thumbnail-cache reuse, carousel wrap/borders, root/NOR artwork and fragmented/large-folder browsing, including recents/empty-list limits.
- Corrected settings/language rendering and persistence, cheat-group selection/scrolling and file-size checks, NOR hints/errors/format/delete feedback, software boot and save-type labels.

Thanks to **FrankieT19**, **EZ-FLASH**, **Sterophonick**, **exploitz86**, **SkillerCMP**, **aidiadayo**, **Kekun** and **ChaN**; and to **michyprima**, **Jaga / EvilJagaGenius**, **Dwedit** and **FluBBa** for the emulator lineage. Merkin Mix artwork and port work is maintained by **Merkin / voluptuary**. [Credits and provenance](https://github.com/voluptuary/dssmm/blob/v8.4.0/ezfomegade/CREDITS.md).

releases.body:
**EZ-FLASH OMEGA Definitive Edition Rev. A/B only.** Do not install on Original OMEGA or the newer DE B / BLUE.

Production/software checks passed; no new Rev. A/B hardware verification was recorded for these audit changes. Flash polling and interrupted NOR/SD replacement limits remain.

Historical release; use the latest model-matched download unless comparing or recovering an older installation. Back up the SD card and saves.

Download **`ezkernelnew.bin`** (2,025,056 bytes). GitHub provides source archives automatically.

SHA-256: `6d7774ecbadc40e8c91d9e0e977fe09cd36abe8ff34462d362557f828f926f38`

### New features

- Freed 832 bytes of working RAM by keeping an unchanged NES patch in read-only storage.

### New fixes

- Bounded NES detection/patching and final cartridge writes; rejected incomplete input and stale detection results.
- Protected the plugin boot stack and raw/compressed handoff, restored small headerless plugins and correct argument names, and rebuilt directory records after failed PSRAM loads.
- Checked staging/save file sizes, exact I/O and close failures; removed incomplete copies and stopped failed save loads before cartridge memory changes.
- Corrected valid Chinese/mixed-case save, backup and artwork paths; tightened cheat identity/game-code sizes and marked-transparency validation.

### Summary of past features

- Mirrored SD artwork with custom/built-in fallbacks, selective marked transparency and refreshed console/splash art.
- Optional browser wrapping.
- Merkin Mix About-screen branding and build number.
- Animated carousels, launch pulse, side previews and CUSTOM Only corners; optional remembered cheats by **exploitz86**, with **SkillerCMP's** groups adapted by **exploitz86**.
- **FrankieT19's DS Style foundation:** list/art/carousel views, title/box art, themes, favorites/recents, customizable Start/help layouts, multilingual controls including Thai/Chinese, text/Markdown viewing, clocks and browser/system-file preferences.
- **FrankieT19's** separate v8.0 Start/UI refinements, loading ring/fade, Auto theme, View/Open SYSTEM/boot/favorites controls; optimized artwork lookup, nested NOR art and selected-game save presentation.
- Themed NOR writing progress with the normal clock and username.

### Summary of past fixes

- Safer NOR catalog/install/delete checks and interrupt restoration; checked SD/save/RTS I/O, bounded paths/cheats and PSRAM patching across 8 MiB banks.
- Long-filename identity, folder display and mirrored-art aliases, fewer directory scans, revised stack/heap placement and BIOS-off launch.
- Reliable image-size guards, first-save cleanup and existing-save error handling; improved flash/format feedback and cheat parsing, with established settings polling retained.
- Bounded fragmented-ROM/save-state FAT transfers.
- Optimized transparent-art row scans; owner-reported responsiveness remained similar, with a possible marginal improvement.
- Corrected transparency/wrap animation and collapsed-cheat rows; improved large/fragmented folders, empty lists/recents, languages/settings, artwork caches and software boot.
- Staged settings/save replacement, corrected save-screen artwork, NOR format/delete/hints/errors, Clean list options, help/LED labels and root artwork.
- Checked game/plugin loading and PSRAM banks, padded incomplete blocks, invalidated reused thumbnail caches and removed the black plugin-launch strip.

DS Style by **FrankieT19**, with **EZ-FLASH** and **Sterophonick** kernel foundations; fork artwork/kernel work by **Merkin / voluptuary**. Thanks to **exploitz86** and **SkillerCMP** for the cheat-menu work. **aidiadayo** contributed Thai support. [Credits and lineage](https://github.com/voluptuary/dssmm/blob/v8.3.2/CREDITS.md).
